concept_distinction.membership_recovery: For q and frozen gallery G, derive V_G(q) from an independent, confirmed object-membership GT manifest intersected with G and excluding q. R1/R2 express pairwise physical semantics; their labeled-edge union must not be used to construct V_G. Confirmed same-object membership stays positive even if pair adjacency is unresolved. Membership closure is independent of pair-adjacency closure.

concept_distinction.r2_local_closure: Closure over direct historical adjacency edges; distinct relation semantics and target.
concept_distinction.physical_assembly: Full geometry assembly or repair is not required by the in-gallery membership target.

minimum_contract_clauses: Independent confirmed object-membership GT manifest with provenance/version and explicit frozen-gallery closure eligibility; derive V_G(q) by intersecting that manifest with G and excluding q. Do not construct member truth from the labeled R1/R2 edge union. Confirmed same-object membership remains positive when pair adjacency is unresolved; exclude from closed-set main evaluation only unresolved membership eligibility or unproven closure. Keep pair-adjacency closure separate.
Separate MemberEpisodeSpec/world generator, truth-side member-set asset and inference result asset/schema; episode_trace remains an observation-action trace.

Inference accepts legal Obs, frozen gallery and public cost/budget/stopping-policy definitions; hidden IDs/full graph/oracle and GT-derived rewards remain offline-only, with rewards used only for training/evaluation and never as deployment observation inputs.
MemberResult includes predicted set, uncertainty/evidence/provenance, explicit open/closed/abstain/unknown statuses, revisions, budget consumption and stop reason.
Hand-computed exact empty/nonempty cases, object-equal then object-macro estimator and source-cluster CI; report fixed-gallery conditionality.
Static member baseline with dev-frozen threshold; B1 scalar relation feedback as ablation; privileged Oracle-R2 offline with matched and shuffled/equal-context controls.
Dedicated A12.22/member acceptance mapped to code/API/asset role/CLI/tests and status; pair A18/A30 or job-recovery A17 cannot substitute.
